title: MSC, then Maersk, Hapag-Lloyd and CMA CGM reroute around the Cape to avoid Red Sea attacks
text: Rerouting runs from mid-December 2023 to February 2024. Port of LA director Gene Seroka calls the early LA impact limited; Asia-US West Coast services are not rerouted, but schedules bunch and some East Coast cargo shifts west.

title: Drought forces Panama Canal to slash transits further
text: Daily transits cut from about 38 to 24, then 18 from February. Some Asia-East Coast cargo shifts to West Coast ports.

title: Port of Los Angeles reports near-record January: 855,652 TEU, +18% y/y
text: January volume 1.1% under the January 2022 record, amid limited Red Sea impact.

title: LA and Long Beach report strong February volumes after Lunar New Year
text: POLA February 781,434 TEU (+60% y/y vs a weak Feb 2023). POLB 674,723 TEU (+24.1%). Seroka expects March near 650k TEU as the post-Lunar-New-Year lull arrives.

title: Port of Los Angeles April cargo: 770,337 TEU, +12% y/y
Port of Los Angeles May cargo: 752,893 TEU, about 3% below May 2023
Port of Los Angeles June cargo: 827,757 TEU; first half up 14%
Panama Canal eases draft and raises daily transits to 35
text: Re-tightened in September (Neopanamax slots cut to 9 from 3 Sep, Panamax to 23 from 15 Sep).

title: Port of Los Angeles: best July in 116 years, 939,600 TEU, +37% y/y
text: Busiest month in more than two years. Seroka: an early peak season has helped boost volumes.

title: Port of Los Angeles August: 960,597 TEU, busiest non-pandemic month; Long Beach sets all-time record
text: POLA +16% y/y. POLB August 913,873 TEU, +33.9% y/y, an all-time monthly record at the time.

title: Section 301 tariff increases on Chinese goods take effect
text: EVs 100%, batteries 25%, solar cells 50%. Analysts say shippers pulled freight forward ahead of the deadline.

title: ILA strike shuts 36 East and Gulf Coast ports
text: About 45,000 dockworkers strike; at least 45 ships anchor off East and Gulf ports by 2 Oct. Seroka: importers had fractionally shifted allocations west; no direct West Coast impact. Strike suspended 3 Oct to 15 Jan 2025.

title: Port of Los Angeles record October: 905,026 TEU, 'without a single ship backed up at sea'
text: +25% y/y, fourth straight month above 900k TEU. Long Beach October 987,191 TEU, an all-time record.

title: Trump promises 25% tariffs on Mexico and Canada and +10% on China
text: Creates an incentive to front-load imports into December and January.

title: Port of Los Angeles November: 884,315 TEU, +16% y/y; Long Beach best November
